dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: It's not bad. After all, liquor from Mondstadt is the best in Teyvat.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: But the Sakoku Decree has really created some difficulty in the transportation of supplies. That's a headache...

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: I have no idea what will happen if we use local ingredients. Ugh...
